playground.title: MCP playground
playground.description: Call this server's tools over the real MCP wire protocol, with your own session token. Every call here is audited like an agent's.
playground.endpointDescription: Point an MCP client at this URL. The JSON-RPC transport (streamable HTTP) is identical for every agent.
playground.authOffWarning: Authentication is disabled: calls run as an anonymous viewer, so permission-gated tools are denied and any process that can reach this URL may call the public ones. Set CLIVER_MCP__AUTH_ENABLED=true to call tools as yourself — and before exposing this server beyond localhost.
playground.authOnNote: Requests must carry a bearer token. Your session token works here — the playground sends it automatically.
playground.cliHint: Add it to an MCP client (Claude Code shown):
playground.headersHint: Agents may identify themselves with the X-MCP-Agent-Type and X-MCP-Agent-Id headers; audits record both.
playground.toolsDescription: tools/list and tools/call exactly as an agent sends them. Permission denials come back as tool errors — that is the enforcement working.
playground.argsObjectRequired: Arguments must be a JSON object, e.g. {"message": "hi"}
playground.resultEmpty: No call yet — pick a tool and call it.
playground.recentDescription: Newest MCP activity, including your calls above.

agents.title: MCP agents
agents.description: Who calls this server's tools, from which machine, with what outcome. Gate rejections (bad or missing tokens) are included.
